First screen 3–4 EXACT potentially substantial targets after reading actual source statements and lower constructions. Check all stronger relevant pinned companions and later versions early. Choose the strongest genuinely remaining target and develop at least TWO serious proof routes; do actual mathematics beyond a catalogue survey. Pay a new estimate/construction rather than restating a missing lemma. Try counterexamples and strongest known reductions. State exact hypotheses, quantifiers, category, parameter dependence, source dependencies and full proof for every positive claim. If unresolved, preserve the deepest paid bridge and precise gap without forced nomination. Numerical evidence is not proof. Distinguish author proof, independently audited theorem, technical consequence, conjecture, falsified proposal and evidence status.

Relate proposed progress to a real significant named problem/MathDB page if available. Cite observed significance evidence only; no invented ranking. Browse current primary literature for niche facts, full relevant proof operations and exact versions; don't substitute search snippets or titles. No worldwide-priority, human-review or formal-certification claim. A full-scope concrete reduction to accepted lower proof operations can defeat substantiality even absent an exact duplicate, but don't dismiss everything merely because classical tools are used.
